transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I suppose… I’m here because I keep checking things at home. Papers, little keepsakes, folders and drawers, boxes I’ve labeled. I’ll look to make sure they’re still there, and then a few minutes later I feel I have to look again. It’s taking up too much of my day.
What goes through your mind when you feel like you need to check these things again?

I know it sounds silly, but I get this thought that maybe I threw away something important… like my husband’s old tax papers, or put a recipe in the wrong box. Even if part of me knows I probably didn’t, it keeps bothering me, like I’ve been careless somehow.
Do you ever feel like you need to check these things because something bad might happen if you don't?

Not exactly something bad, no… it’s more that I feel I have to open the folders or drawers again, or the labeled boxes, just to be sure the papers and keepsakes are still where I left them. Even if I only looked a few minutes before.
Do you feel anxious or uneasy when you can't check these things?

Yes… uneasy, I suppose. If I can’t check, it sits in my mind that those papers or keepsakes might not be where I left them. I end up wanting to open the same folders or boxes again, even if I only looked a few minutes before.
Do you ever feel like you need to check these things to prevent something from happening, like losing something important?

Yes… I suppose that’s part of it. I keep opening the same folders or drawers, the labeled boxes, just to make sure the important papers and keepsakes are still there. Even if I checked only a few minutes before, I feel like I have to look again.
Do you feel like you're checking these things because you're afraid of making a mistake if you don't?

Yes… I think so. It’s like a thought keeps poking at me that maybe I threw out my husband’s old tax papers, or put a family recipe in the wrong box. I know it probably isn’t true, but I can’t quite let it go… it feels terribly careless if I don’t check.
Do you ever feel like you have to think certain thoughts or repeat certain words to yourself to relieve the anxiety from not checking?

Not really certain words, no. It’s more that I feel I have to go back and look again… open the same folders or boxes, check the drawers, make sure the papers and keepsakes are still there. Even if I just did it.
Do you ever feel like you have to think about certain things in a specific way to relieve your anxiety?

Not in a particular way, no. It’s more… I just feel pushed to look again. The folders, drawers, those labeled boxes… to make sure the papers and keepsakes are still where I left them, even if I only checked a few minutes before.
Do you feel like you have to mentally replay conversations or events to relieve your anxiety?

Not really replaying conversations, no. It’s more… I keep going back to check the same folders and drawers and boxes, to be sure the papers or keepsakes are still there. Even if I only looked a few minutes before.
Do you feel like you have to perform a specific action, like arranging or ordering things, when you have these thoughts about checking?

Not so much arranging things. It’s more the checking itself… opening the same folders or drawers, those labeled boxes, just to be sure the papers and keepsakes are still there. Even if I only looked a few minutes before.
Do you feel like you have to think about certain things over and over to relieve your anxiety about the papers and keepsakes?

Not so much thinking it through over and over. It’s more that I have to go look again… open the same folders or drawers, the labeled boxes, just to be sure those papers and keepsakes are still there. Even if I checked a few minutes ago.
Do you feel like you have to think about certain things in your mind, like counting or repeating phrases, when you're checking these papers and keepsakes?

No… I don’t think it’s counting or saying phrases in my head. It’s just that I feel I have to open the folders or drawers again, or look in the labeled boxes, to make sure the papers and keepsakes are still there. Even if I checked already.
Do you feel like you have to think about certain things in your mind to make the anxiety from not checking go away?

Not really in my mind, no. It’s more… I feel I have to go and look again — the folders, drawers, those labeled boxes — just to be sure the papers and keepsakes are still where I left them. Even if I only checked a little while before.
Do you feel like you have to think about certain things in a specific order to relieve your anxiety about the papers and keepsakes?

No… not a specific order in my head. It’s more that I keep going back and opening the same folders, drawers, and labeled boxes to make sure the papers and keepsakes are still there. Even if I just checked.
Do you feel like you have to check these things because you would feel mentally uncomfortable if you didn't?

Yes… I suppose so. If I don’t check, I get very uneasy. I keep feeling like I need to open the folders or drawers again, just to be sure the papers and keepsakes are still there… even if I only looked a few minutes before.
Do you ever worry that something bad might happen to you or someone else if you don't check these things?

Not something bad exactly… not like anyone would be hurt. It’s more this thought that keeps bothering me, that I might have thrown away my husband’s old tax papers, or put a family recipe in the wrong box. I know it may not make sense, but it feels like I’ve done something terribly careless if I don’t check.
Do you ever feel like you need to check these things because you're worried something might be contaminated or harmed if you don't?
No… I don’t think it’s about contamination. I’m not worried they’ll be harmed in that way. It’s more just… needing to be sure, I suppose.
Do you feel like checking these things helps you avoid making a mistake that would have significant consequences?

Yes… I think so. I keep checking the same folders and drawers because I’m afraid I’ve made some mistake with important papers or keepsakes. Even if I just looked, I don’t feel settled until I look again.
Do you believe that if you didn't check these things, you would be responsible for a serious mistake?

Yes… I suppose that’s the feeling. Even if I know better, it keeps needling at me that I may have thrown away something important, like my husband’s old tax papers, or put a recipe in the wrong place. And then it feels like I’ve been terribly careless if I don’t check.
Do you feel like you need to check these things to make sure everything is in its exact right place?

Yes… mostly. I keep opening the same folders and drawers, the labeled boxes too, just to be sure the papers and little keepsakes are where I left them. Even if I checked a few minutes before, I still feel I have to look again.
